app.name: Sensei
app.tagline: Malaminka na kanka, a kowane harshe
app.offlineTooltip: Sensei yana aiki ne a kan na'urarka ta gida. Babu wani abu a wannan shafin da aka loda daga wani waje.
errors.title: Wani abu ya sami matsala
errors.generic: Mun kasa loda wannan. Mai yiwuwa ba za a iya tuntuɓar uwar garken malamin ba.
errors.offline: An kasa tuntuɓar uwar garken Sensei.
errors.offlineHint: An gwada {url}. Duba ko akwatin yana aiki kuma yana kan hanyar sadarwa.
errors.notFoundBody: Wannan hanyar ba ta wanzu a cikin Sensei.
errors.subjectNotFound: Wannan darasin ba ya cikin tsarin karatu.
empty.subjectsBody: Tsarin karatu na wannan akwatin babu komai. Loda tsarin darussa domin farawa.
empty.lessons: Babu darussa a cikin wannan rukunin tukunna
empty.questions: Ba a sami tambayoyin gwaji ba
empty.questionsBody: Gwada wani darasin daban, ko kuma faɗaɗa matatun bincike.
empty.lessonContent: Wannan darasin ba shi da rubutaccen bayani tukunna
empty.lessonContentBody: Darasin yana nan a cikin tsarin karatu amma ba a samar da bayanan koyarwar ba tukunna. Har yanzu za ka iya tambayar Sensei game da shi.
empty.progress: Ba a bibiyi komai ba tukunna
empty.progressBody: Kammala darasi ko tambayar gwaji kuma ƙwarewarka za ta bayyana a nan.
dashboard.subtitle: Ci gaba daga inda ka tsaya, ko kuma fara wani sabon abu.
dashboard.continueEmptyBody: Zaɓi darasi kuma Sensei zai jagorance ka mataki-mataki ta hanyar tambayoyi.
dashboard.minutesLearned: Minti nawa aka yi ana koyo
dashboard.nextUpBody: Abin da aka ba da shawarar ka koya bisa ga inda kake a tsarin karatu.
dashboard.quickPracticeBody: Tambayoyin jarrabawar baya guda biyar, tare da amsa nan take.
dashboard.askAnythingBody: Fara tattaunawa ta musamman da Sensei don neman ƙarin bayani.
catalog.title: Darussa
catalog.subtitle: Tsarin karatu da aka ɗora a wannan akwati. Kowane babi yana dacewa da darasin manhaja.
course.aboutBody: Sensei yana koyar da wannan darasi ne ta hanyar Socratic — ba zai ba ka amsoshi kai tsaye ba. Kowane darasi yana biye da matakan koyarwa guda biyar, tun daga fahimtar farko har zuwa gwajin gwaninta.
course.selectLessonBody: Zaɓi darasi daga hagu don ganin manufofinsa da kuma fara koyo.
course.noMatches: Babu darussan da suka dace da wannan tacewa.
lesson.steps: Yadda Sensei zai koyar da wannan
lesson.stepHints.intro: Sensei zai fara da tambaya don gano abin da kuka riga kuka sani.
lesson.stepHints.concept: Tunanin kansa, wanda aka gina shi daga amsarku maimakon a karanta muku shi.
lesson.stepHints.teach: Yadda yake aiki — rubutu, auna, da tsarin da aka saba amfani da shi.
lesson.stepHints.practice: Za ku yi guda daya. Sensei zai lura da inda kuke shakka.
lesson.stepHints.mastery: Gwajin jarrabawa mai wuya don tabbatar da cewa tunanin ya zauna sosai.
lesson.tutorPanelSubtitle: An gina shi a kan wannan darasin
lesson.resizeHandle: Ja don sauya girman sashin malami
tutor.title: Tambayi Sensei
tutor.subtitle: Koyarwa irin ta Socratic. Zai yi maka jagora ne, ba zai ba ka amsa kai-tsaye ba.
tutor.placeholder: Yi tambaya game da wannan darasin…
tutor.placeholderFree: Me kake koya a halin yanzu?
tutor.loadingModel: Ana loda samfurin gida — wannan na iya ɗaukar 'yan mintoci…
tutor.emptyTitle: Sensei ba ya bayar da amsa kai-tsaye
tutor.emptyBody: Yana yin tambayar da za ta kai ka ga amsar ne. Fara daga ko'ina a ƙasa.
tutor.emptyBodyLesson: Yi tambaya game da kowane abu a wannan darasin, ko ka fara da ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan.
tutor.composerHint: Danna Enter don aikawa · Shift+Enter don sabon layi
tutor.prompt1: Ina da jarrabawa nan da mako uku — a ina ya kamata na fara?
tutor.prompt2: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa binciken siffofi (dimensional analysis) ke gano kuskuren lissafi.
tutor.prompt3: Ina yawan samun kuskuren alama (+/-) a darasin kinematics. Taimaka mini in gano inda matsalar take.
tutor.prompt4: Ba ni tambaya guda daya mai wahala kuma kada ka gaya mini amsar.
tutor.promptHardest: Mene ne mafi wahalar darasi a cikin {subject} kuma me yasa?
handwriting.title: Nuna aikinka
handwriting.subtitle: Dauki hoton shafi ko ka bincika shi kuma Sensei zai gano inda ka yi kuskure.
handwriting.accepted: PNG, JPG ko WebP, har zuwa 8 MB
handwriting.tooLarge: Wannan hoton ya wuce 8 MB. Gwada hoto mafi kankanta.
handwriting.wrongType: Wannan ba fayil din hoto ba ne.
handwriting.notWiredTitle: Ba a haɗa karatun hoto a wannan uwar garken ba
handwriting.notWiredBody: Wannan sigar ta Sensei API tana nuna hanyar koyarwa ta JSON ne kawai — babu hanyar hoto tukunna, saboda haka ba za a tura hoton koina ba. Malamin zai ci gaba da karbar tambayarka ta rubutu. Da zarar an kara hanyar gani a baya, wannan bangaren zai tura hoton tare da ita.
handwriting.notWiredShort: Ba a tura ba — babu hanyar hoto a wannan uwar garken tukunna
handwriting.sendAnyway: Yi tambaya a kai ta rubutu
handwriting.requiresVision: Hakanan yana bukatar samfurin da ke da ikon gani — duba Saituna.
practice.title: Ayyuka
practice.subtitle: Tsoffin tambayoyin jarrabawa na gaske. Daya bayan daya, tare da amsa nan take.
practice.subject: Darasi
practice.correctBody: Wannan ita ce amsar. Ga dalilin da ya sa ya kasance haka.
practice.incorrectBody: Kusa da ita — an samu kuskure a wani wuri. Bari Sensei ya nemo inda kuskuren yake.
progress.title: Ci gaba
progress.subtitle: Abin da ka kware a kai, da kuma abin da ke bukatar gyara.
progress.conceptHint: Ana sanya wa kowane darasi alamar jigo. Kammala darasi yana haɓaka fahimtar jigoginsa.
progress.reset: Sake saita duk wani ci gaba
progress.resetConfirmBody: Wannan zai goge duk darasin da aka kammala, jerin kwanaki, da sakamakon gwaji da aka adana a wannan burauzar. Ba za a iya dawo da shi ba.
progress.localOnlyNote: Ana adana ci gaba a wannan burauzar kawai — Sensei API na wannan na'urar ba shi da hanyar adana bayanan ɗalibi tukunna.
settings.title: Saituna
settings.subtitle: Harshe, samfuri da bayyanar shafi.
settings.languageBody: Tsarin karatu da koyarwa za su koma zuwa wannan harshen.
settings.appearanceBody: Yanayin duhu ya fi sauƙi don dogon nazari na yamma.
settings.modelBody: Wanne samfuri ne zai ba ka amsa. Cloud yana da sauri; na cikin na'ura ba ya fita waje.
settings.noVisionWarning: Samfuran rubutu kawai ba za su iya karanta rubutun hannu ba.
settings.swapWarningTitle: Wannan zai canza samfurin da aka ɗora
settings.swapWarningBody: Samfura guda ɗaya ne kawai na cikin na'ura ke zama a raye. Loda {model} yana ɗaukar mintuna 1–5, yana dakatar da wannan buƙatar, kuma yana shafar kowa da ke amfani da wannan akwatin.
settings.swappingBody: Na'urar tana canza samfurin da ke raye. Kada ka rufe wannan shafin — wannan zai iya ɗaukar har mintuna biyar.
settings.serverBody: Sensei API ɗin da wannan abokin ciniki ke magana da shi.
settings.serverStatusDown: Ba za a iya samunsa ba
settings.privacyBody: Wannan shafin ba ya loda kowane nau'in rubutu, rubutun kwamfuta, hotuna ko bincike daga wasu kamfanoni na daban. Gidan yanar gizo guda ɗaya tilo da yake tuntuɓa shi ne saba na Sensei da ke sama.
